decisions.reason: The ACE3 distributed airfield lighting control unit builds directly on the firm's core ALCMS know-how and was launched as its newest industry-standard solution, and in-house R&D lets the firm interpret early results and refine it, so withdrawal within a year is very unlikely.

The air situation display extends the firm's established tower and surveillance offer, where its integration and R&D capabilities give it enough related knowledge to assimilate feedback and improve the product, so it is likely kept despite less prominent website coverage.
